CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to the identified content.

COD.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (red coordinates), describes its presentation (red/blue partitioning) and separately provides origin/status metadata for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The text names a specific represented content (referent) and an attribute (red) with explicit coordinate listing.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is provided separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report specifies how the content is presented (partitioned red vs blue coordinate sets) for the named referent/time.
